say:1:1130323001:1.text: Soren was originally of the Grimmaw Clan, but we exiled him as a weakling.
say:1:1130323001:1.source_cn: 索恩本来是我们黑嚎氏族的人，虽然我们之前把弱小的他丢掉——
say:1:1130323001:1.male: Soren was originally of the Grimmaw Clan, but we exiled him as a weakling.
say:1:1130323001:1.female: Soren was originally of the Grimmaw Clan, but we exiled him as a weakling.

say:2:1130323002:1.text: But survival of the fittest is the way of all the clans! Strength comes first!
say:2:1130323002:1.source_cn: 但适者生存，弱肉强食，是氏族保证实力的老规矩罢了！
say:2:1130323002:1.male: But survival of the fittest is the way of all the clans! Strength comes first!
say:2:1130323002:1.female: But survival of the fittest is the way of all the clans! Strength comes first!

say:3:1130323003:1.text: Hailing from the Grimmaw Clan, he should understand such principles!
say:3:1130323003:1.source_cn: 既然身为黑嚎氏族，就该接受这样的规矩！
say:3:1130323003:1.male: Hailing from the Grimmaw Clan, he should understand such principles!
say:3:1130323003:1.female: Hailing from the Grimmaw Clan, he should understand such principles!

say:4:1130323004:1.text: No matter. Orson will make short work of him!
say:4:1130323004:1.source_cn: 不过没关系，奥格会把他打得满地找牙的！哼。
say:4:1130323004:1.male: No matter. Orson will make short work of him!
say:4:1130323004:1.female: No matter. Orson will make short work of him!
